name: Codos (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow stripe with a pointed edge fimbriated red along the hoist, charged with a red cross with branches.
history: Municipal flag of Codos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
